Notes.value:
Should we work with him? Yes – Great enthusiasm. And works very, very hard. We would need to manage his time.

About: Born in the Canary Islands. Started coding at a very young age. Coding first and designing second, got back into development. "99% development and 1% design" :) "I like to do things I've never done before". Shared office with feijoomontenegro.com. Open to working with e-commerce. Enjoys projects with a lot of interaction, something more immersive. Super cheerful guy. Very hard working it seems.

Skills / Stack: Wordpress CMS, using Craft recently. Frontend: Vue.js, Nuxt.js. Nginx, AWS, Ubuntu VM, Node.js, Snipcart.js. Not super proficient in the WebGL frameworks. Familiar with Git Flow.

Availability: Freelancing (4 years), usually works with studios in UK, US, Spain. Sounds very in demand.

Rate: Generally does fixed price. Be paid once the job is finished. Makes a base budget for the studio, adaptable.

Past projects mentioned: Fran Rios / Querida contacted him asking if it was feasible, showing/doing them stuff. Casual. 2000K. Bite → one of his friends' brands, a free project for a friend that grew and grew; explored more options while working on it. 6000, 7000K + 10,000K with design.
